title: Pokemon TCG Inteleon Rebel Clash 050/192 Holo Card
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText: The 2020 Inteleon VMax 050/192 Ultra Rare Full Art Holo Pokemon TCG card is a highly sought-after collectible for fans of the Pokémon Trading Card Game. Manufactured by Nintendo, this card features the character Inteleon in a stunning full art design with a holographic finish, making it a standout addition to any collection. As part of the Rebel Clash set, this VMAX card is sure to be a prized possession for collectors and players alike.
